items.name: Khan Academy Kids
items.description: A 100% free, ad-free early learning app created with Stanford educators. Kids build reading, math, logic, and social-emotional skills through adaptive games, digital storybooks, and creative drawing tools.

items.name: PBS Kids Games
items.description: Hundreds of ad-free mini-games featuring beloved characters like Daniel Tiger and Wild Kratts. Helps toddlers and preschoolers practice counting, rhyming, and problem-solving—even offline once downloaded.

items.name: Pok Pok
items.description: A calm, Montessori-inspired digital playroom with no timers, high scores, or loud flashing rewards. Encourages toddlers and young kids to explore open-ended toys, puzzles, music, and everyday life at their own pace.

items.name: Kids Academy
items.description: A structured PreK–Grade 3 learning program combining interactive games, letter tracing, Singapore Math, phonics, and printable worksheets to guide kids step-by-step through core school subjects.

items.name: Duolingo ABC
items.description: Short, playful, ad-free lessons that teach young children letter sounds, phonics, handwriting, and sight words. Builds early reading confidence in just a few minutes a day.

items.name: Teach Your Monster to Read
items.description: Kids design their own monster and go on a magical adventure where they master letter sounds, word blending, and reading full sentences. Free to play on desktop web browsers.

items.name: Epic!
items.description: An interactive digital library with over 40,000 popular kids' books, audiobooks, and "Read-to-Me" stories that highlight words aloud—making independent reading fun and accessible.

items.name: Libby (by OverDrive)
items.description: Connects directly to your local public library card so kids can borrow thousands of picture books, chapter books, and audiobooks for free on any tablet or phone.

items.name: Prodigy Math
items.description: Turns Grade 1–8 math practice into a fantasy adventure game where kids battle monsters and complete quests by solving curriculum-aligned math problems tailored to their skill level.

items.name: Moose Math
items.description: Created by Duck Duck Moose and Khan Academy, this free app teaches counting, addition, subtraction, shapes, and sorting through cheerful carnival and town-building mini-games.

items.name: SplashLearn
items.description: Personalized PreK–Grade 5 math and reading lessons that use visual models and interactive games to explain tricky topics like fractions, geometry, and multiplication.

items.name: ScratchJr
items.description: Designed by MIT for young learners, kids snap together colorful visual blocks to make characters move, jump, dance, and tell stories—learning coding logic before they even need to read.

items.name: Scratch
items.description: The world's largest free coding community for kids. Young creators build their own playable games, animations, and interactive stories using visual block programming.

items.name: Thinkrolls
items.description: Clever physics-based maze puzzles where kids use gravity, heat, elasticity, and force to guide rolling characters to the finish line—sharpening logic and spatial reasoning.

items.name: Duolingo
items.description: Bite-sized daily lessons in 40+ languages with speaking, listening, and reading exercises. Great for older kids who can read comfortably and enjoy streak-based motivation.

items.name: BrainPOP / BrainPOP Jr.
items.description: Short, witty animated movies that break down complex science, history, social studies, and health topics into easy-to-understand stories, followed by interactive quizzes and activities.
